outcome: Detection rate of cesarean scar defect (CSD)
Agreement between saline contrast sonohysterography (SCSH) and transvaginal sonography (TVS) in evaluating CSD
cohort: 102 women who underwent primary cesarean section
finding: Cesarean scar defects are better evaluated by SCSH than TVS, with SCSH detecting more defects and providing better evaluation of shape, borders, and size.
mod_finding: Cesarean scar defects were better evaluated by SCSH than TVS in women who underwent cesarean section.
